high_level_description: stc brand style, a nighttime promotional image for the 'ANA ARABIA' event in Riyadh.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A modern building with geometric architectural patterns and warm golden lighting, pink feather-like light installations at the top of the frame, captured at night.

elements.desc: A figure in a flowing white dress, standing with their back to the camera, silhouetted against the illuminated building.
The event name in white capital letters on the right side of the frame.
The venue name in pink text below the event title.
The event dates in white text below the venue name.
